BiblicalUsage: Paul calls the Thessalonians' suffering a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God in 2 Thessalonians 1:5 — their endurance under persecution is the visible evidence that they will be counted worthy of the kingdom.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe suffering borne patiently is evidence, not accident — it shows whose kingdom we belong to.
